text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
Not only have I obtained a broader<n>understanding of
leisure pursuits, but<n>a bounty of plushies, too. Two
birds<n>with one stone, as they say.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
Thank you for stepping up to the plate<n>in my place.
You took to that claw<n>machine like a fish to water.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
As it happens, I have thought of the<n>perfect pun to
commemorate your<n>achievement.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text: You really clawed your way to theheights of success.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
Quite the gutbuster, if I do say so<n>myself. Well,
don't hold back! Let<n>yourself laugh!
